pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit higher spatial area compared to those on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-pointed. Pixel thickness is variable, with wider pathways observed on the neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal neck. Bristles appear as a dark, continuous line with a jagged silhouette against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, circular area of dark hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the upper flank near the posterior dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism perched on the dorsal ridge near the rump, creating a localized silhouette irregularity.
